description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package. It provides static methods for stream manipulation, request modification, URI handling, and other common operations used internally by the PSR7 implementations.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for stream handling, request modification, URI processing, and other common tasks in GuzzleHttp PSR7.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes specified keys from data array case insensitively.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from source stream to destination stream, up to a maximum length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads data from a stream until a maximum length or EOF and returns it as a string.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a stream's contents using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Clones and modifies an HTTP request based on provided changes.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from a stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: redactUserInfo
methods.description: Redacts the password in the user info part of a URI.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from various resource or data types.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Safely opens a PHP stream resource, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: tryGetContents
methods.description: Safely retrieves contents from a stream, throwing on failure.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Returns a UriInterface instance for the given string or UriInterface, creating a new one if needed.
